title: Repair mobile News reader and add bilingual language control
question: Can the existing News reader keep its quiet editorial layout while making mobile loading stable, stock selection/search usable and Chinese/English UI switching available on both editions?
hypotheses: The persistent blank blocks come from author CSS overriding the hidden attribute on the loading skeleton container.
A native mobile search plus select control can reuse the existing stock state and payload without changing the data gateway or desktop navigation.
A small contract test can prevent both regressions without requiring a new browser or backend dependency.
A shared, local language dictionary can translate reader UI, controls and dates without changing source RSS titles or summaries when the formal payload has no authoritative bilingual fields.
acceptance_criteria: After payload load, loading skeletons are removed and remain hidden; no persistent blank shimmer blocks remain.
Both /tw and /us expose usable mobile search and stock selection controls with labels, keyboard support and state parity with the desktop index.
Both /tw and /us expose a persistent Chinese/English toggle that localizes UI labels, dates and controls without altering source RSS text.
Desktop stock index, newest-first reading order, data gateway and read-only polling behavior remain unchanged.
Contract, JavaScript syntax, diff hygiene and live mobile route checks pass before release.
evidence: Owner supplied a mobile screenshot showing persistent loading blocks and reported that stock selection/search is unavailable in both languages.
Source inspection reproduced the CSS hidden-state collision and found the mobile picker to be an inert informational button.
